Note on estimates: Road-surface conversion is costed at the confirmed rate of ₹3,500/sqm (Gravel/Mud → Concrete), applied consistently across all wards. UGD, Attachment, SWG, Jalasiri and Signage rates are placeholder assumptions — one documented rate table applied uniformly to every ward for comparability — pending confirmation of official schedule-of-rates figures. Fields marked "Unknown" reflect a "??" entry from the original field survey, not a data error. A small number of source rows had inconsistent units (widths entered in mm instead of m, pipe dia in m instead of mm) — these were detected and normalized automatically; one distance value in Ward 25 (5,530 m for a single segment) looks like a likely data-entry error and was left as recorded since the correct value can't be inferred.
